gap: The Google website button sends people to a Facebook page, so homeowners who want cabinets, furniture or carpentry have to message on Facebook or call; there's no simple place to send measurements and photos for an estimate.

hero.headline: Custom carpentry and furniture in Lumberton, built exactly how you want it.
hero.subhead: Custom cabinets, furniture, decks and ramps across Lumberton, Purvis, Hattiesburg and the Pine Belt. Send your idea with a few photos or measurements and get a clear estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the Vicknair Carpentry assistant. Thinking about cabinets, a piece of furniture or a carpentry job? Tell me about it and I'll help you get an estimate.

about.headline: Woodwork made for your home, not off a shelf.
about.body: Cabinets that fit the space you actually have, furniture built to last, a ramp that makes getting in and out of the house easy again. You want someone who listens to what you have in mind and builds exactly that.

cards.title: Furniture for your home

cards.title: Easier access at home
cards.body: Ramps and steps added to decks and porches so getting around is safe again.

about.closing: Got an idea but no drawings? Send a photo and a rough size.

problems.headline: Getting custom woodwork made in the Pine Belt shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Projects that stall halfway with no update.

realReviews.author: karen bates
realReviews.text: He built a ramp onto my front deck so I can get in and out of my home now with my walker or motorized scooter. The quality of his work is BEYOND AWESOME!!!! If you want the best price and top quality work, HIRE HIM!!!!

realReviews.author: Walker Evans
realReviews.text: Hired multiple times. Thomas always delivers exactly what you want.

finalCta.headline: Got a piece or a project in mind?
finalCta.body: Send a few details, photos or measurements, or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear estimate before anything is built.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a conversation about what you'd like made.
